about.label: About RFALA
about.title: Two decades of technology. One ecosystem built for the future.
paragraphs: What started in 2006 as ryztech.com has grown into RFALA, a full technology and innovation ecosystem with Moroccan roots and global ambitions.
Over 20 years, we have built digital products, helped businesses grow online, developed platforms, and invested in education and community impact across multiple industries.
Today, RFALA operates through focused initiatives: Xenova Studio, Maroclist, Islamic School Review, and RFALA Institute, each solving real problems for businesses, learners, and communities.
RFALA is not just a company. It is an ecosystem built on two decades of experience, designed to create, innovate, and shape the future.

institute.title: Learning Pathways for the AI Era
paragraphs: RFALA Institute combines top educational resources from leading universities and learning platforms with live mentorship, guided instruction, and market-focused learning pathways.

Instead of depending on a single institution, RFALA creates customized learning experiences using the best content from platforms such as MIT Open Learning, Harvard Online, Coursera, and other world-class educational providers.

RFALA Institute also runs hands-on AI bootcamps: intensive, project-based programs where participants build real AI skills with guided instruction and mentorship. Every graduate receives an RFALA Institute certificate of completion recognizing the skills they have demonstrated.

water.name: RFALA Water Intelligence
water.tagline: Satellite & AI-Powered Water Intelligence for Agriculture
water.summary: Combines satellite imagery, terrain analysis, and AI-assisted analysis to identify areas with potential groundwater resources and help reduce uncertainty before drilling.
description: RFALA Water Intelligence is a geospatial intelligence platform designed to help farmers, agricultural investors, and landowners make better-informed decisions about groundwater exploration.

It combines satellite imagery, geographic data, environmental indicators, terrain analysis, and AI-assisted analysis to identify areas with potential groundwater resources, and to help users understand where further investigation may be appropriate before investing in costly drilling.
water.noteBody: Results support groundwater exploration decisions and prioritize areas for further investigation. They do not guarantee that water is present or that a well will produce. Confirm findings with a field survey and a qualified professional before drilling.

careerai.name: RFALA CareerAI
careerai.summary: Designed to help job seekers find relevant opportunities and prepare personalized applications, including job-specific cover letters.
description: CareerAI helps job seekers find relevant opportunities and prepare personalized applications using AI. Users upload a resume and create an AI-powered career profile.
The platform can analyze job descriptions, compare requirements with the candidate's experience, and help prepare personalized application materials, including job-specific cover letters.
careerai.noteBody: CareerAI helps you find relevant opportunities, prepare personalized applications, and streamline the process. It does not apply to every job automatically. Where automated submission is supported, it follows the applicable platform's terms and requires your authorization. Outcomes such as interviews or offers are not guaranteed.

advisory.label: Service
advisory.name: Technology & Product Advisory
advisory.tagline: Turn your technology investment into the right product.
advisory.intro: RFALA provides independent technology and product oversight for businesses working with developers, freelancers, or technology teams.
body: We bridge the gap between the business owner and the development team, helping translate your vision into clear requirements, manage priorities and timelines, review quality and deliverables, and keep the product aligned with your business objectives.

Beyond project management, RFALA's founder brings more than 30 years of hands-on experience in IT, AI, data, and enterprise technology, helping identify opportunities, improve the product, and guide technology decisions from concept through delivery.
advisory.independence: Independent oversight. RFALA works on your behalf alongside the developers you choose. We do not replace your development team.
provide: Final delivery and product readiness review
advisory.ideal: Businesses that have an idea, product, or active development project and want an experienced technology partner to help ensure the right product is built and delivered successfully.
advisory.closing: Your idea. Your investment. Your product. RFALA helps keep it aligned with the value you envisioned.
